# Game-Maker: Sandbox Edition

> Make DOS-style games in your web browser with no programming: a free, open-source remake of Recreational Software Designs’ Game-Maker 3.0 (1994). Draw blocks and monsters, build maps, add music and sound, play the original sample and shareware games, and export your game as a web page, a web app or for DOS.

A modified fork of RSD Game-Maker 3.0 — not an original RSD release. It runs entirely in the browser (no account, no server): games are kept in the browser's storage and the site works offline. Every file it writes is in the original Game-Maker 3.0 / PLAYGAME formats (.gam, .pal, .bbl/.mbl/.cbl, .chr, .mon, .map, .snd and the standard .gif, .fli, .cmf, .voc), so games run in DOS (or DOSBox) as well. Game-Maker and its PLAYGAME player are re-implemented in TypeScript from the released C source; it is not a PC emulator, and no DOS or x86 code runs (some hardware is emulated: VGA mode 13h and the OPL2 FM sound chip). The site opens on a recreated 1994 desk with a simulated DOS PC running Game-Maker's ported designers; today's web interface is one click away.

## The app

- [Game-Maker: Sandbox Edition](https://lewismoten.github.io/GameMaker-SandboxEdition/): opens on the 1994 desk or today’s web editor, whichever the visitor used last
- [DOS Game-Maker](https://lewismoten.github.io/GameMaker-SandboxEdition/dos.html): the 1994 PC on its own, straight into Game-Maker; dos.html?game=<id> opens a game in it
- [Guide](https://lewismoten.github.io/GameMaker-SandboxEdition/#/help): how to use the editor: blocks, monsters, characters, maps and scenes, sounds and music, testing and exporting
- [Player](https://lewismoten.github.io/GameMaker-SandboxEdition/play.html): plays one game full-window; each game below has its own page (play-<id>.html), and play.html?game=<id> plays it too
- [Sitemap](https://lewismoten.github.io/GameMaker-SandboxEdition/sitemap.xml)

## Source code and file formats

- [Source code](https://github.com/lewismoten/GameMaker-SandboxEdition): the repository on GitHub: the web app (TypeScript, Vite), the new games, and the original 1994 release
- [Repository README](https://github.com/lewismoten/GameMaker-SandboxEdition/blob/master/README.md): what is in the repository and how it is published
- [Web app README](https://github.com/lewismoten/GameMaker-SandboxEdition/blob/master/web/README.md): building, running and testing the web app
- [Source map](https://github.com/lewismoten/GameMaker-SandboxEdition/blob/master/web/src/README.md): what each folder of the web app holds and how the pieces fit
- [File formats](https://github.com/lewismoten/GameMaker-SandboxEdition/tree/master/web/src/formats): readers and writers for every Game-Maker file, byte for byte (Borland C++ 16-bit layout: int is 2 bytes, structs are packed)
- [Game engine](https://github.com/lewismoten/GameMaker-SandboxEdition/tree/master/web/src/engine): a TypeScript port of PLAYGAME.C
- [Original DOS source](https://github.com/lewismoten/GameMaker-SandboxEdition/tree/master/code/GM): the C source of RSD Game-Maker 3.0, released under the MIT License in 2014
- [Making the new games](https://github.com/lewismoten/GameMaker-SandboxEdition/blob/master/games/README.md): the Sandbox Software games, each built in code into real Game-Maker files
